receipt.architecture: Actual native RuVector evidence ranking with the unchanged official DeBERTa-v3-large reader. Each selector uses one exact source premise for original H and full-proposition NOT H. Raw threeway outputs are mirrored and averaged. The actual rawH native pass is retained as a same-premise causal control at no extra forward. Neutral and conflict uncertainty are retained; missing retrieval or missing entailment does not establish contradiction or insufficient evidence. No fitting, temperature selection, source rewriting, new model or official benchmark claim.

No new model,training,temperaturegrid,ANNgrid or annotationrelabeling.
